title: Hopewell Ceremonial Earthworks
summary: The Hopewell Ceremonial Earthworks are eight earthwork sites in southern Ohio built roughly 1,600 to 2,000 years ago, attributed to the Hopewell culture of about 100 B.C. to A.D. 400. They include Newark’s Great Circle (30 acres) and Octagon sites, Fort Ancient and Mound City. UNESCO designated them on 19 September 2023, the 25th US World Heritage site.

uncertainty.note: Ohio State University gives the Hopewell culture as from about 100 B.C. to A.D. 400; NPS says the earthworks were built between 1,600 and 2,000 years ago.
